answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a flat, non-refundable entry tax before acting, blocking any gale of fake sign-ups. The fee is a mesa — flat at 60 credits, no discounts, no refunds — and mirrors one genuine agent's onboarding cost. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 credits sunk. An honest agent pays 60 once and keeps its earnings; rented identities pay again, since the tax sticks to the identity and any transfer restarts it.
